topic: Steps in a Simple Scientific Investigation
key_concepts: Science process skills include observing, inferring, measuring, communicating, classifying
Observing uses the senses to gather information about an object or event
Inferring is making an educated guess based on previously gathered data
Measuring uses standard or nonstandard measures to describe dimensions
Communicating describes an action, object, or event using words or graphic symbols
Classifying groups objects or events into categories based on properties or criteria
Predicting states the outcome of a future event based on a pattern of evidence

A control setup is used for comparison in an experiment
All conditions should be kept the same except the variable being tested
Ice cubes melt faster in warmer areas and in direct sunlight than in cooler or shaded area
Scientific investigations can be used to solve real-world problems
